verdict.seen: Cut face of soil, a pit gets dug and trash bags pile on its floor, but no truck is visible and the top edge of the frame is cut off.
verdict.problem: No truck arrives in any frame; show the truck driving up to the pit and keep the pit and ground fully in view.

verdict.seen: Trash bags in a pit with arrows pointing down, a brown leachate zone spreading down and the groundwater turning yellow/polluted across the frames.
A clay-lined pit holds the trash bags with seepage arrows still going down. The clay base is not clearly thick and the bags are not lifted in the first frame.
verdict.problem: Show the bags lifting clearly and a distinctly thick clay base layer being laid under them.

verdict.seen: The pit is lined with a dark black plastic sheet that appears across the frames over the clay, with the bags sitting in it.
A pit with a dark liner and a thin yellow outline around the pit, with trash bags inside.
verdict.problem: The yellow outline is very thin and hard to read at phone size; make the liner outline thicker and brighter.

verdict.seen: A white pipe grows under and beside the pit, running up to a blue tank beside the pit across the frames.
The pit fills with stacked layers of bags separated by soil layers and is capped with soil, sealed by the liner.
A readable newspaper, The Daily News, 'New Highway Opens', sits in the pit on soil, and the view is close up.
A vent pipe stands on the soil cap and small bubbles are barely visible among the bags, with the newspaper fading in the first frame.
verdict.problem: Bubbles are tiny and hard to see; make gas bubbles larger and rising toward the pipe.

verdict.seen: A flare with an orange flame sits on top of the vent pipe, and a generator box beside it is connected by a pipe.
The pit is capped with grass, a white fence appears and young trees are in place on the lawn.
The camera pulls back to show the whole finished landfill with its grass cap, fence, flare, tank, and groundwater below, nothing covering it.
